customer: Hello, I recently traded in my pickup truck with Northwind Auto here in Eastvale, and with a newborn at home I'm trying to keep our bills straight. Could you tell me whether I should still be making payments on the truck loan, or has that been taken care of? Thank you so much for your help.
agent: Congratulations on the new baby, and thanks for checking with us! As explained in our article "Should I keep making loan payments?", please keep making your regular loan payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off. Our payoff covers the amount your lender quoted, and a missed payment in the meantime can be reported as late on your credit history. If a payment goes through after the payoff, your lender will refund it to you; see "Getting back an extra loan payment" for more on that.
